explanation: He first called it Mintonette. At an early demonstration a watcher said the players seemed to be volleying the ball, and the new name stuck.

claims.text: William G. Morgan invented volleyball in 1895 in Holyoke, Massachusetts, as a less strenuous indoor game than basketball.
Morgan did not invent netball, handball or badminton.
Morgan originally named the game Mintonette.
The name volleyball came from an observer at an early demonstration who remarked that the players were volleying the ball.
